## Checkpoint and changes

Describe which checkpoint this addresses and what changed in each application.

## Evidence and human review

- [ ] I reviewed Copilot-generated changes rather than accepting them blindly.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and reported actual outcomes, separately from structural checks.
- [ ] Photo behavior, authentication, validation, CSRF, and persistence remain covered.
- [ ] No credentials, real customer data, or fabricated success evidence are included.
- [ ] I did not weaken the grader, skip tests, or disable protection to get a green result.
- [ ] Any cloud action remains explicitly approved and scoped to the dedicated lab.
